name: ExportDialog
intent: Export configuration dialog — file type (PDF/Excel), whether active filters narrow the export, and which saved template to use or a new one to generate.
when: A list or table surface needs an export affordance with more than one choice
Exports are shaped by reusable report templates

chooseOver.because: A menu fits one axis of choice; ExportDialog carries four that must be seen together before committing
Dialog is the empty shell; ExportDialog is the ready-made export form with its own submission contract

commonMistakes.mistake: Perform the export inside the dialog
commonMistakes.fix: The dialog only collects the selection — do the work in onExport
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Perform the export inside the dialog — handle it in onExport

commonMistakes.mistake: Pass activeFilterCount that disagrees with the surface's real filter state
commonMistakes.fix: Derive it from the same applied-filter value the list uses

notes: Composed from Dialog + RadioGroup + Select + Switch + Input; owns no export behaviour of its own

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit to let the dialog manage its own.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog. Omit when driving `open` yourself.

props.name: templates
props.description: Saved templates to pick from. Empty/omitted leaves only the one-off export.

props.name: activeFilterCount
props.description: Shown beside the scope toggle so the user knows what "current filters" means.

props.name: defaultDateRange
props.description: Seeds the date range each time the dialog opens — e.g. the range already applied to the list.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

usage: Use ExportDialog when you need to display content that temporarily overlays the main interface. This component is useful for focused interactions, confirmations, or supplementary information.
ExportDialog should be used sparingly as overlays interrupt the user's workflow. Reserve this component for important interactions that require user attention or action before continuing.

anatomy.description: ExportDialog is composed of the following parts:

parts.name: ExportDialogTrigger
parts.description: Element that opens the dialog when activated.

parts.name: ExportDialogContent
parts.description: Container for the dialog content and overlay.

parts.name: ExportDialogHeader
parts.description: Header section containing title and description.

bestPractices.title: Focus management
bestPractices.description: Trap focus within the dialog and return focus when closed.

bestPractices.title: Don't nest dialogs
bestPractices.description: Avoid opening dialogs from within dialogs, use sequential flow instead.

bestPractices.title: Provide clear exit
bestPractices.description: Always include a visible close button and support Escape key.

bestPractices.title: Don't trap users
bestPractices.description: Never make dialogs impossible to close or require specific actions to dismiss.
bestPractices.example: // No close button or escape handling

bestPractices.title: Keep content focused
bestPractices.description: Limit dialog content to a single task or decision.

bestPractices.title: Don't overload dialogs
bestPractices.description: Avoid putting complex forms or multiple tasks in a single dialog.
